name: Lamia Matriarch Sorcerer (CR 20)
body:
LAMIA MATRIARCH SORCERER
CR 20

Lamia matriarch sorcerer (wildblooded) 8/archmage 8
CE Large monstrous humanoid (mythic, shapechanger)
Init +13, amazing initiative; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 14, flat-footed 28 (+11 armor, +5 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 178 (12d10+8d6+60+24)
Fort +9, Ref +15, Will +16
Defensive Abilities enduring armor, force of will, hard to kill, mythic saves, recuperation, unstoppable; Immune mind-affecting effects; SR 19

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
Melee +1 conductive unholy scimitars +21/+21/+16/+16/+11/+6 (1d6+8/15–20/x3 +2d6 vs. good creatures, plus 1 Wisdom drain on first hit each round) or unarmed strike +23/+23/+18/+18/+14/+9 (1d3+7 plus 1d4 Wisdom drain), bite +25 (1d6 + lycanthropy, DC 19)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft., 15 ft. with touch attack (long limbs)
Special Attacks archmage arcana (mage strike), contagious attack, mythic power 19/day, surge +1d10, wisdom drain
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th; concentration +20)

At will—charm monster (DC 22), ventriloquism (DC 18)
11/day—warp touch (DC 24)
3/day—deep slumber (DC 21), dream, major image (DC 21), mirror image, suggestion (DC 21)

Spells Known (CL 14th; concentration +22)

7th (4/day)—blasphemy M (DC 25)
6th (6/day)—blade barrier M (DC 24), dimensional blade
5th (7/day)—caustic blood M (DC 25), contact entity III, shapechanger’s gift M
4th (8/day)—black tentacles M, hunger for flesh M (DC 22), stoneskin, unholy ward
3rd (8/day)—excruciating deformation M (DC 23), haste, magic circle against good, tongues B, toxic blood (DC 23)
2nd (8/day)—death knell (DC 20), extreme flexibility, invisibility, overstimulate, see invisibility B, storm of blades M
1st (8/day)—cure light wounds, divine favor, enlarge person B (DC 21), inflict light wounds (DC 19), mage armor, magic missile
0 (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 18), detect magic, ghost sound (DC 18), mage hand, mending, prestidigitation, read magic, touch of fatigue (DC 18)

Bloodline Aberrant/Warped

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 21, Con 17, Int 18, Wis 15, Cha 26
Base Atk +16; CMB +24; CMD 39 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Combat Casting, Double Slice, Eschew Materials *, Extend Spell M, Improved Critical M (scimitar), Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Unarmed Strike *, Iron Will, Sorcerous Strike, Spell Focus M (transmutation), Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus M (scimitar)
Skills Acrobatics +9 (+12 jump), Bluff +35, Climb +15, Diplomacy +14, Disguise +14, Intimidate +35, Knowledge (arcana) +27, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +27, Spellcraft +27, Swim +15, Use Magic Device +35; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Bluff, +4 Use Magic Device
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Common, Draconic
SQ abundant casting, bloodline arcana, change shape (fixed Medium humanoid form, alter self ), eldritch breach, extended abundant casting, mindthrall, mythic bloodline, mythic spellcasting, undersized weapons
Gear two +1 co0nductive unholy scimitars, 2 flasks of devil’s spit (120 gp), prophetic paraphernalia, sleeves of many garments, sorcerer’s kit (8 gp), 42 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Contagious Attack (Su)

A non-humanoid mythic monster can infect a creature with a natural attack (most often claw or bite), causing it to transform into one of its own kind through a painful process that lasts for 1d6 minutes.

The infected creature’s alignment and statistics change to those of its final form, though it could retain its memories if its Intelligence doesn’t decrease to animal level. This is considered a form of lycanthropy curse and can be reversed or cured in the same ways. If the monster has not a suitable natural attack, it gains one, dealing damage as fit for its size.
